_doc: D2-style potions (ruling 23): a potion refills over `secs` and drinking another stacks a second refill on top (chug them back to back in an emergency). Sizes by area level come from rarity.json `potions`. Belts hold potions in `potionSlots` slots (the belt's implicit), each slot a stack of up to `stack` of the same potion; Q drinks the first health potion, E the first mana potion. In the bag a potion stack takes one cell. `price` is the vendor's (M13).
